connector.name: Instagram MCP by adelaidasofia
connector.registryDescription: Official, multi-account Instagram Graph API MCP: read, publish, analytics, comments, DMs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package adelaidasofia-instagram-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the adelaidasofia account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: INSTAGRAM_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Long-lived Graph API token (optional; or use add_account at runtime, stored in OS keychain).

env.name: INSTAGRAM_MCP_IG_USER_ID
env.description: Numeric Instagram Business/Creator account id paired with the access token.
